description: This file defines the 'HolidayAPI' class, a PHP REST API endpoint for managing holiday entities, including operations such as fetching, creating, updating, and deleting holidays within a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: HolidayAPI
classes.description: A REST API class providing CRUD operations for Holiday entities, enabling clients to retrieve, create, update, and delete holiday records within the HRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Holiday entity by its ID and returns it in a standardized API response.

methods.name: getIdFromUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts the holiday ID from the URL parameters.

methods.name: getIdParamRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of holidays based on specified filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new holiday record based on the request payload.

methods.name: setHolidayParams
methods.description: Populates a Holiday entity object with data from the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create method.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Defines common validation rules applicable for both creation and update of holiday entities.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing holiday record specified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more holiday records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete method.
